How to use this
  1. Flip through fonts with Next / Previous or the arrow keys. Click ☆ on any you like.
  2. Open "Compare fonts side by side" to see the logo in many fonts at once. Click one to use it.
  3. Adjust size, spread, colors and the graphic in the panels on the right.
  4. Download a PNG (for websites) or SVG (for printing), and copy "What you picked" to send to David.

Fonts are free Google Fonts, loaded from the internet as you browse, so you need to be online. Your favorites and settings are remembered in this browser.

Each tile uses your current words, colors and graphic. Click a tile to use that font; click ☆ to add it to favorites.
